sources.entry: NodeBB - Forum software built for the modern web. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: NodeBB is a Node.js forum software that runs on Redis, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL and adds real-time discussions via web sockets.
summary.what_it_does: NodeBB is a forum application built on Node.js that can store data in Redis, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL. It uses web sockets to deliver instant interactions and real-time notifications. The README describes it as keeping traditional bulletin-board features such as categorical hierarchies, local user accounts, and asynchronous messaging, while adding streaming discussions and RESTful read/write APIs. A common core provides basic functionality, and extra features and integrations come from third-party plugins. Theming is supported through base templates with SCSS or CSS styling, and the base theme uses Bootstrap 5. Translations are managed through Transifex.
use_cases: build a forum with a custom theme
how_to_run: ./nodebb setup (configure database, admin account, and port; default port 4567)
Alternatively, run docker-compose up to start NodeBB with its required services
stack: MongoDB (5 or greater) or Redis (7.2 or greater)
notable: Supports Redis, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL as the backing database
Real-time notifications and streaming discussions via web sockets
Functionality extended through third-party plugins on a common core
Theming via base templates with SCSS or CSS
caveats: Clustering requires Redis to be installed and configured
Uses a CLI-based setup and does not run via standard npm start
Commercial sublicense available for non-GPL use, per the README
